{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_patients}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline}')

# Check if any patient has multiple sample_seq entries
patient_sample_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
retested_patients = patient_sample_counts[patient_sample_counts > 1].count()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq entries: {retested_patients}')"}
